source.coordinate_system: Original overhead-image pixels: origin top left, x right, y down. Angled-image coordinates are not used for any outline or point.
source.map_area_convention: [left, top, right, bottom]; right and bottom exclusive; pixels of original image; x right, y down
source.geometry_convention: Clockwise outlines in y-down image coordinates, not repeated closed vertex. Roof/main structure envelopes are simplified; obscured ground footprints are approximate. height_m is roof height above local ground/platform, not absolute terrain altitude.
source.rotation_convention: rotation_deg is clockwise from image +x to the first polygon edge, modulo 180; positive y points down. It is a drafting reference edge, not necessarily the pad long axis or in-game heading.

scale.how: One shared X/Y scale for the whole source image, fitted by least squares in metres to the listed independent visible pad-side controls; uniform fallback when directional scales are not identifiable or would require excessive stretch.
scale.basis: User-confirmed classes, user working dimensions Large170x90m, Medium135x70m, Small70x50m.
limitations: A confirmed class does not identify a precise mechanical deck boundary: traced paint/apron envelopes are approximate.
One shared transform retains residuals at individual pads. Reference dimensions are not forced independently on each pad.
Reconstructed hidden edges are inferred, not additional calibration observations. Negative/out-of-image pixels are permitted only for documented reconstructions.
Camera perspective, roof parallax and terrain can cause local differences; estimates are unsuitable for survey accuracy.
No statistical confidence interval is claimed. Roof heights and floor estimates are preserved.

fingerprint.description: Detached western landing area with one large pad and two smaller pads. Eastern accommodation cluster has four small rounded HABs, a larger northeast HAB, and a larger southwest HAB beside PWR. A diagonal walkway crosses a visible ravine/depression on a bridge between the two accommodation groups.

uncertain: All heights are low-confidence schematic estimates from a single oblique image. Major floor counts are estimates; no door access number has been converted into a floor number or height.
Footprints trace main visible roof/building envelopes; overhangs, roof depth, icon occlusion and perspective prevent a surveyed ground-level perimeter.
The southwest HAB has a visibly raised central mass and a literal 2^ access marker; precise floor connectivity and the caret meaning are unverified.
The bridge crosses a visible depression, but neither bridge deck elevation nor terrain elevation can be recovered accurately from this pair. No shadow outline is encoded as geometry.
Unlabelled landing-service structures are included as other with low confidence; smaller equipment boxes, loose containers and props are omitted.
All points use visible icon centres. The physical doorway or terminal can be displaced relative to the oversized editorial symbol.
No ships, vehicles, people, rocks or shadows are traced. Blue i and orange i icons are editorial/UI annotations and must not be extruded into world objects.
No map pixels are stretched or reprojected. Pixel outlines remain in the original 1644 x 925 source coordinate system.
No point has an independently verified physical storey from these two views; floor is null even when its icon shows an access number, L0, > L0 or carets.
All at coordinates are the printed annotation centres; editorial placement can be offset from the physical object. Some touching circles are individually recorded.
The orange top-left information button is retained as scope map_ui for complete icon transcription, and should not be drawn as a physical settlement object.

previous_scale.how: Approximate small northern pad envelope has a long edge about 130 px and a short edge about 87 px. Assuming community nominal small-pad dimensions 66 x 55 m gives 66/130 = 0.508 m/px and 55/87 = 0.632 m/px; arithmetic mean = 0.570 m/px. This is a schematic estimate only. The photographed Odyssey paved/painted boundary may not match those nominal dimensions; the long/short estimates differ by about 22% of their mean and the large-pad envelope gives a different fit. No surveyed dimension or terrain elevation is available.
previous_scale.reference_status: Community nominal landing-pad dimensions supplied as an assumption; not a calibration of this particular Odyssey pad.

Colonisation.metric_height_policy: Prior roof/storey/equipment height estimates are retained, with their original confidence/basis. The revised pad-based registration updates horizontal metres and visible footprint dimensions.

geometry_m.superseded_note: Kept for traceability. site_m holds the plan fitted to SrvSurvey's measured positions, in SrvSurvey's site frame.

frame.origin: Settlement position from the journal (ApproachSettlement Latitude/Longitude), as SrvSurvey uses it
frame.heading: Site heading = ship heading while docked on pad 1, or ship heading minus that pad's rotation_deg on any other pad (SrvSurvey HumanSiteData).
frame.to_world: bearing = heading + atan2(x, y); east = x*cos(h) + y*sin(h); north = -x*sin(h) + y*cos(h)
frame.rotation_convention: rotation_deg and rot_deg are clockwise from +y
frame.floor_convention: SrvSurvey floors: 1 = ground floor, 2 = one floor up, 3 = two floors up. SrvSurvey also uses 0: on every combat-zone point and on a few others, where its meaning isn't documented; those are copied as given. floor_basis says where each floor came from: srvsurvey, or icon carets (the plan's ^ marks, no caret = ground floor). plan_floor keeps the plan's reading where SrvSurvey's differs.
frame.access_convention: Security level 0-3: SrvSurvey's level where matched, otherwise the plan's printed number
frame.source_convention: plan = only on the plan; srvsurvey = only in SrvSurvey; plan+srvsurvey = both, at SrvSurvey's position

site_m.pixel_to_site_note: [X, Y, W] = M . [px, py, 1]; site = (X/W, Y/W). Third row is [0, 0, 1] for a uniform fit.

flags: source image needed a perspective correction (local scale 0.348-0.688 m/px)
